'''Michael Hunt''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who appears as a [[:Category:Radio DJs|radio DJ]] in [[Grand Theft Auto III]], as a radio caller in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]] and as a radio DJ in [[Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories]]. He is voiced by [[Russ Mottla]].

==Character history==
Michael Hunt was born in [[San Fierro]] and in [[1992]] lived at home with his mother in the city describing his home as one with a backyard where he could cut grass. By [[1998]], he had moved to [[Liberty City in GTA III Era|Liberty City]], become the [[:Category:Radio DJs|DJ]] of [[Head Radio]], had a son and later been banned from seeing his son after developing an extreme drug addiction. He uses clichés such as "rock around the clock 24/7" and "non-stop rock" during his broadcasts. During this time he develops a vendetta against the [[Lips 106]] station for playing "Top 40" music rather than "real rock and roll music". His name is a "censored" form of the gag name ''Mike Hunt'' (my cunt). Hunt may be self-conscious about this as he almost always inserts a nickname for himself, one example being "Mike 'Wheels of Steel' Hunt".
